# Draft:My Talking Tom 2

My Talking Tom 2 is a game released by Outfit7 on November 3, 2018. It is a sequel to the original My Talking Tom game released on November 11 2013. Unlike the original game, the game features new additions such as plane tokens and pets.
The game officially included promo codes and events collabrating ententies and special events.
